title: 雙光子顯微鏡~Two-photon microscopy
focus: I² 非線性激發、脈衝寬度與重複率、散射深度與色散預補償的工程預算~Engineering budgets for I² nonlinear excitation, pulse width and repetition rate, scattering depth and dispersion precompensation
summary: 從雙光子吸收率與強度平方成正比出發，理解為何飛秒脈衝、高數值孔徑與非去掃描偵測能在散射組織深處取得固有光學切片，再把脈衝展寬、散射長度、功率與熱負載、點擴散函數校正和共振掃描時序整合成可驗收的雙光子成像系統。~Start from the quadratic intensity dependence of two-photon absorption to see why femtosecond pulses, high numerical aperture and non-descanned detection give intrinsic optical sections deep in scattering tissue, then integrate pulse broadening, scattering length, power and heat load, point-spread calibration and resonant-scan timing into an acceptable two-photon imaging system.

units.anchor: 焦點處的 I² 激發體積~I² excitation volume at the focus
units.title: 雙光子吸收與固有光學切片~Two-photon absorption and intrinsic optical sectioning
units.mechanism: 雙光子激發要求兩個近紅外光子在飛秒內同時被同一分子吸收，速率正比於強度平方 I²，所以只有焦點附近強度最高的微小體積才有效發光；離焦平面的總激發量隨離焦距離以 1/z² 衰減，不需要針孔就能切片。要把平均功率不高的光做到足夠的瞬時強度，必須用鎖模雷射把能量壓縮成約 100 fs 的脈衝，並以約 80 MHz 重複；在固定平均功率下，脈衝越短、重複率越低，每個脈衝的激發機率越高。~Two-photon excitation needs two near-infrared photons absorbed by the same molecule within femtoseconds, at a rate proportional to the squared intensity I², so only the tiny volume of highest intensity around the focus emits efficiently; the total excitation in out-of-focus planes falls as 1/z² with defocus, giving sectioning without a pinhole. To reach sufficient instantaneous intensity from modest average power, a mode-locked laser compresses the energy into pulses of about 100 fs repeated at about 80 MHz; at fixed average power, shorter pulses and lower repetition rate raise the excitation probability per pulse.
units.model: 每脈衝每分子吸收的光子對數 n_a ≈ δ·P²/(τ·f²)·[NA²/(2ħcλ)]²。取 δ = 30 GM（3×10⁻⁵⁷ m⁴·s）、P = 10 mW、τ = 100 fs、f = 80 MHz、NA = 1.0、λ = 920 nm：P²/(τf²) ≈ 1.56×10⁻⁷ J²/s，[NA²/(2ħcλ)]² ≈ 2.96×10⁶² J⁻²m⁻⁴，n_a ≈ 0.14。發射率 ≈ n_a·f·Φ ≈ 0.14×8×10⁷×0.8 ≈ 9×10⁶ 光子/s；脈衝縮短一半或重複率減半，n_a 都加倍。~Photon pairs absorbed per molecule per pulse: n_a ≈ δ·P²/(τ·f²)·[NA²/(2ħcλ)]². With δ = 30 GM (3×10⁻⁵⁷ m⁴·s), P = 10 mW, τ = 100 fs, f = 80 MHz, NA = 1.0 and λ = 920 nm: P²/(τf²) ≈ 1.56×10⁻⁷ J²/s, [NA²/(2ħcλ)]² ≈ 2.96×10⁶² J⁻²m⁻⁴, so n_a ≈ 0.14. The emission rate ≈ n_a·f·Φ ≈ 0.14×8×10⁷×0.8 ≈ 9×10⁶ photons/s; halving the pulse width or the repetition rate doubles n_a.
units.verify: 在均勻螢光素溶液中量螢光對雷射功率的對數斜率，應接近 2；再用自相關儀改變脈衝寬度（例如以預啁啾量調整），確認同功率下螢光與 1/τ 成正比，兩項結果一起證明激發是雙光子過程。~Measure the log-log slope of fluorescence against laser power in a uniform fluorescein solution, which should be close to 2; then vary the pulse width with the autocorrelator as reference (for example through the prechirp setting) and confirm that fluorescence at constant power scales as 1/τ, which together prove a two-photon process.
units.failure: 功率推到每脈衝接近一個光子對時激發飽和，斜率從 2 降到 1 以下，點擴散函數變寬、切片變厚，且焦點處的高階吸收造成不可逆損傷。~Driving power until each pulse yields nearly one photon pair saturates the excitation, the slope drops from 2 to below 1, the point-spread function broadens, sectioning thickens, and higher-order absorption at the focus causes irreversible damage.
units.misconception: 雙光子顯微鏡需要針孔才能得到光學切片。~A two-photon microscope needs a pinhole to obtain optical sections.

units.anchor: 散射組織中的彈道光子~Ballistic photons in scattering tissue
units.title: 散射長度、穿透深度與波長選擇~Scattering length, penetration depth and wavelength choice
units.mechanism: 激發只靠到達焦點的彈道光子，而彈道功率隨深度按 exp(−z/l_s) 衰減，雙光子訊號因此按 exp(−2z/l_s) 下降；要維持訊號必須讓表面功率隨深度指數上升。近紅外波長越長散射越弱，920 nm 在腦皮質的散射長度約 200 µm，1300 nm 約 350 µm，所以長波長能以更少功率到達同樣深度，代價是水的吸收上升與可用的螢光蛋白較少。當表面附近的離焦雙光子背景與焦點訊號相當時，就到達成像深度極限。~Excitation relies only on ballistic photons reaching the focus, and ballistic power decays with depth as exp(−z/l_s), so the two-photon signal falls as exp(−2z/l_s); keeping signal constant requires surface power to rise exponentially with depth. Longer near-infrared wavelengths scatter less: in cortex the scattering length is about 200 µm at 920 nm and about 350 µm at 1300 nm, so the longer wavelength reaches the same depth with less power, at the cost of higher water absorption and fewer suitable fluorescent proteins. The depth limit is reached when out-of-focus two-photon background near the surface equals the focal signal.
units.model: 維持焦點激發不變所需的表面功率 P(z) = P₀·exp(z/l_s)。P₀ = 10 mW、l_s = 200 µm 時 600 µm 深需 10×e³ ≈ 201 mW；改用 1300 nm、l_s = 350 µm 只需 10×e^(600/350) ≈ 56 mW。文獻報導腦組織的穩態溫升約為每 100 mW 平均功率 1 到 2 K，因此 200 mW 已接近熱安全邊界。~Surface power needed to hold focal excitation constant is P(z) = P₀·exp(z/l_s). With P₀ = 10 mW and l_s = 200 µm, a depth of 600 µm needs 10×e³ ≈ 201 mW; at 1300 nm with l_s = 350 µm only 10×e^(600/350) ≈ 56 mW. Reported steady-state heating of brain tissue is about 1 to 2 K per 100 mW of average power, so 200 mW already approaches the thermal safety boundary.
units.verify: 在含 1% 脂肪乳劑的瓊脂假體中埋入螢光珠，量各深度維持相同珠子亮度所需的功率，對深度取對數擬合出 l_s，與文獻值比較；再用插入式熱電偶或溫敏染料確認長時間掃描時的溫升。~Embed fluorescent beads in an agarose phantom with 1% lipid emulsion, measure the power required to keep bead brightness constant at each depth, fit the logarithm against depth to extract l_s and compare with literature; then confirm temperature rise during long scans with an inserted thermocouple or a temperature-sensitive dye.
units.failure: 為了在 800 µm 深度得到影像，把平均功率提高到 300 mW 以上，表面附近的離焦激發淹沒訊號且組織局部加熱，影像對比不升反降並伴隨光損傷。~Raising average power above 300 mW to image at 800 µm lets out-of-focus excitation near the surface swamp the signal and heats the tissue locally, so contrast falls rather than rises and photodamage follows.
units.misconception: 只要功率夠大，雙光子就能成像到任意深度。~With enough power two-photon imaging reaches any depth.

units.anchor: 預啁啾稜鏡對與自相關儀~Prechirp prism pair and autocorrelator
units.title: 飛秒雷射、群延遲色散與脈衝預補償~Femtosecond laser, group-delay dispersion and pulse precompensation
units.mechanism: 鈦藍寶石雷射可在 680 到 1080 nm 調諧，摻鐿光纖雷射提供 920 或 1030 nm 的固定波長與較高功率。脈衝通過聲光調制器、掃描透鏡、管鏡與物鏡時，群延遲色散使不同波長成分延遲不同，脈衝在樣品處被展寬數倍，雙光子訊號按 1/τ 下降。預補償以稜鏡對、光柵對或啁啾鏡在雷射出口加入負色散，使脈衝到達焦點時最短；二氧化碲調制器的色散特別大，是常被忽略的來源。~Ti:sapphire lasers tune from 680 to 1080 nm, while ytterbium fibre lasers give fixed 920 or 1030 nm output at higher power. As pulses pass the acousto-optic modulator, scan lens, tube lens and objective, group-delay dispersion delays spectral components differently, so the pulse at the sample stretches several times and two-photon signal falls as 1/τ. Precompensation adds negative dispersion with a prism pair, grating pair or chirped mirrors at the laser output so that the pulse is shortest at the focus; tellurium-dioxide modulators have especially large dispersion and are an often overlooked source.
units.model: 高斯脈衝經群延遲色散 GDD 後 τ_out = τ_in·√(1 + (4ln2·GDD/τ_in²)²)。τ_in = 100 fs、顯微鏡總 GDD ≈ 5000 fs² 時 4ln2×5000/10⁴ ≈ 1.39，τ_out ≈ 100×√(1 + 1.92) ≈ 171 fs，訊號只剩 100/171 ≈ 58%；預補償 −5000 fs² 可還原到 100 fs，殘留 ±500 fs² 時展寬不到 1%。~A Gaussian pulse after group-delay dispersion GDD has τ_out = τ_in·√(1 + (4ln2·GDD/τ_in²)²). With τ_in = 100 fs and a microscope GDD ≈ 5000 fs², 4ln2×5000/10⁴ ≈ 1.39 and τ_out ≈ 100×√(1 + 1.92) ≈ 171 fs, leaving only 100/171 ≈ 58% of the signal; precompensating −5000 fs² restores 100 fs, and a residual of ±500 fs² broadens by less than 1%.
units.verify: 把自相關儀放在物鏡後（以相同物鏡或等效玻璃），量樣品面脈衝寬度並掃描預補償量，找出最短脈衝點；再用螢光素溶液確認訊號在同一設定達最大，兩者的 GDD 設定應一致。~Place the autocorrelator after the objective (using the same objective or equivalent glass), measure the pulse width at the sample plane while scanning the precompensation and find the minimum; then confirm with a fluorescein solution that the signal peaks at the same setting, which should agree with the GDD value.
units.failure: 更換成色散較大的新物鏡卻沿用舊的預啁啾設定，樣品處脈衝從 100 fs 變成 200 fs，使用者以為雷射功率下降而調高功率，造成不必要的熱負載。~Switching to a new objective with larger dispersion while keeping the old prechirp setting stretches the pulse at the sample from 100 to 200 fs; the user, assuming the laser has lost power, raises the power and adds needless heat load.
units.misconception: 雷射規格書上的脈衝寬度就是樣品處的脈衝寬度。~The pulse width in the laser datasheet is the pulse width at the sample.

units.anchor: 大瞳孔物鏡與非去掃描偵測器~Large-pupil objective and non-descanned detector
units.title: 物鏡、光束擴束與非去掃描偵測~Objective, beam expansion and non-descanned detection
units.mechanism: 雙光子用低放大率、高數值孔徑、長工作距離的水浸物鏡，其後孔徑可達 15 到 20 mm，雷射光束必須擴束到填滿後孔徑才能得到設計的數值孔徑與最小激發體積。螢光從深處出射時幾乎全部被散射，離開表面時分布在遠大於焦點的區域；非去掃描偵測把 GaAsP 光電倍增管放在物鏡後方最近處，以大面積直接收集，而不是把光送回掃描器與針孔。偵測路徑只需阻擋激發光，不需成像品質。~Two-photon systems use low-magnification, high-NA, long-working-distance water-immersion objectives whose back apertures reach 15 to 20 mm, and the laser beam must be expanded to fill that aperture to obtain the design NA and the smallest excitation volume. Fluorescence leaving deep tissue is almost entirely scattered and emerges over an area far larger than the focus; non-descanned detection places GaAsP photomultipliers as close as possible behind the objective to collect over a large area instead of returning light through the scanner and a pinhole. The detection path only has to block the excitation and needs no imaging quality.
units.model: 25×/1.05 水鏡配 180 mm 管鏡，f_obj = 7.2 mm，後孔徑 ≈ 2·NA·f = 15.1 mm；從 2 mm 雷射光束擴到 15 mm 需 7.5 倍擴束。視場 = 視場數/放大率 = 18/25 = 0.72 mm。雙光子點擴散函數（1/e 半徑）ω_xy ≈ 0.325·λ/(√2·NA^0.91) ≈ 0.21 µm、ω_z ≈ 0.532·λ/[√2(n − √(n² − NA²))] ≈ 0.76 µm，半高寬約 0.35 與 1.27 µm，激發體積 ≈ π^1.5·ω_xy²·ω_z ≈ 0.19 fL。~A 25×/1.05 water objective with a 180 mm tube lens has f_obj = 7.2 mm and a back aperture ≈ 2·NA·f = 15.1 mm, so a 2 mm laser beam needs 7.5× expansion. Field of view = field number/magnification = 18/25 = 0.72 mm. The two-photon point-spread function (1/e radii) is ω_xy ≈ 0.325·λ/(√2·NA^0.91) ≈ 0.21 µm and ω_z ≈ 0.532·λ/[√2(n − √(n² − NA²))] ≈ 0.76 µm, FWHM about 0.35 and 1.27 µm, with an excitation volume ≈ π^1.5·ω_xy²·ω_z ≈ 0.19 fL.
units.verify: 在物鏡後孔徑位置用光束輪廓儀量光束直徑，確認 1/e² 直徑不小於孔徑；以 0.2 µm 螢光珠量三維半高寬並與 0.35、1.27 µm 比較；比較同一深度非去掃描與去掃描路徑的訊號比，記錄隨深度的增益。~Measure the beam diameter at the objective back aperture with a beam profiler and confirm the 1/e² diameter is not smaller than the aperture; measure the three-dimensional FWHM with 0.2 µm fluorescent beads against 0.35 and 1.27 µm; compare signal through the non-descanned and descanned paths at the same depth and log the gain with depth.
units.failure: 光束只填滿後孔徑的 60%，有效數值孔徑降到約 0.63，軸向半高寬變為 3 µm 以上，激發體積膨脹且同樣功率下 I² 訊號大減，深層影像模糊。~A beam filling only 60% of the back aperture lowers the effective NA to about 0.63, the axial FWHM grows beyond 3 µm, the excitation volume swells, the I² signal at the same power drops sharply and deep images blur.
units.misconception: 偵測器放在哪裡都一樣，只要擋掉雷射就好。~Detector placement does not matter as long as the laser is blocked.

units.anchor: 樣品面功率計與功率平方曲線~Sample-plane power meter and P² curve
units.title: 功率、脈衝與點擴散函數校正~Power, pulse and point-spread calibration
units.mechanism: 因為訊號與功率平方成正比，功率的校正誤差會被放大兩倍；Pockels 盒的穿透率對電壓是正弦曲線，必須以樣品面的功率計建立對照表並定期重量。脈衝寬度要在樣品面以自相關儀量，雙曲正割脈衝的自相關半高寬是脈衝寬度的 1.54 倍。點擴散函數以 0.2 µm 珠子在表面與深處各量一次，判斷光束填充、色散與球差狀態。~Because signal scales with the square of power, any power calibration error is doubled; the transmission of a Pockels cell is sinusoidal in voltage, so a lookup table must be built with a power meter at the sample plane and re-measured periodically. Pulse width is measured at the sample plane with an autocorrelator, where the autocorrelation FWHM of a hyperbolic-secant pulse is 1.54 times the pulse width. The point-spread function is measured with 0.2 µm beads at the surface and at depth to judge beam filling, dispersion and spherical aberration.
units.model: 功率誤差 1% 造成訊號誤差 2%，5% 造成 10%。自相關半高寬 263 fs 對應 263/1.54 ≈ 171 fs 的脈衝，表示預補償不足；達到 154 fs 的自相關才對應 100 fs。功率系列 5、10、20 mW 量到相對訊號 1、4.1、16.4，log-log 斜率 log(16.4)/log(4) ≈ 2.02，確認平方律。~A 1% power error gives a 2% signal error and 5% gives 10%. An autocorrelation FWHM of 263 fs corresponds to a 263/1.54 ≈ 171 fs pulse, indicating insufficient precompensation; only a 154 fs autocorrelation corresponds to 100 fs. A power series at 5, 10 and 20 mW giving relative signals 1, 4.1 and 16.4 has a log-log slope log(16.4)/log(4) ≈ 2.02, confirming the square law.
units.verify: 每週用熱電堆功率計在物鏡後量 10 個 Pockels 設定的功率並更新對照表；每次更換物鏡或波長後量自相關；每月量表面珠子的三維半高寬，與驗收基準比較並畫趨勢圖。~Weekly, measure power after the objective at 10 Pockels settings with a thermopile power meter and update the lookup table; after every objective or wavelength change measure the autocorrelation; monthly, measure the three-dimensional FWHM of surface beads and plot the trend against the acceptance baseline.
units.failure: 用雷射出口的功率值換算樣品功率而忽略物鏡在 920 nm 僅約 70% 的穿透率，實際功率低估 30%，訊號預期值錯 50% 以上，且不同系統間的結果無法比較。~Converting laser-output power to sample power while ignoring an objective transmission of only about 70% at 920 nm underestimates the real power by 30%, puts the expected signal off by more than 50% and makes results incomparable across systems.
units.misconception: 功率計放在雷射出口量到的值可以直接當作樣品面的功率。~Power measured at the laser output can be used directly as power at the sample.

units.anchor: 光子計數直方圖與熱負載估計~Photon-count histogram and heat-load estimate
units.title: 散粒雜訊、偵測器雜訊與熱負載預算~Shot noise, detector noise and the heat-load budget
units.mechanism: 雙光子影像每像素的光子數常只有個位數到數十個，散粒雜訊主導；光電倍增管的增益起伏再引入過量雜訊因子 F，GaAsP 管約 1.2 到 1.4，使有效信噪比下降。改善途徑是提高每脈衝激發效率、增加停留時間或幀平均，而非單純加功率。熱負載來自水對近紅外的吸收與組織散射後的沉積，與平均功率成正比；1300 nm 的水吸收比 920 nm 高約 20 倍，同樣功率下發熱更明顯。~A two-photon image often holds only single digits to tens of photons per pixel, so shot noise dominates; gain fluctuations of the photomultiplier add an excess-noise factor F of about 1.2 to 1.4 for GaAsP tubes, lowering the effective signal-to-noise ratio. Improvement comes from higher per-pulse excitation efficiency, longer dwell or frame averaging rather than simply more power. Heat load comes from water absorption of near-infrared light and deposition of scattered light, proportional to average power; water absorbs about 20 times more at 1300 nm than at 920 nm, so the same power heats more.
units.model: SNR ≈ N/√(F·N)：N = 10 個偵測光子、F = 1.3 時 SNR ≈ 10/√13 ≈ 2.8；4 幀平均 ≈ 5.5，16 幀 ≈ 11。水的吸收係數約 0.06 cm⁻¹（920 nm）對約 1.3 cm⁻¹（1300 nm）；以每 100 mW 約 1.8 K 的報導值估計，920 nm 下 150 mW 平均功率的穩態溫升約 2.7 K。~SNR ≈ N/√(F·N): with N = 10 detected photons and F = 1.3, SNR ≈ 10/√13 ≈ 2.8; averaging 4 frames gives ≈ 5.5 and 16 frames ≈ 11. Water absorption is about 0.06 cm⁻¹ at 920 nm versus about 1.3 cm⁻¹ at 1300 nm; using the reported value of about 1.8 K per 100 mW, 150 mW average power at 920 nm produces a steady-state rise of about 2.7 K.
units.verify: 以光子計數模式記錄均勻螢光片的像素直方圖，計算平均與變異數之比得到有效的 F；比較 1、4、16 幀平均的 SNR 是否按 √N 提升；在假體中以熱電偶量不同平均功率的穩態溫升並與線性模型比較。~Record the pixel histogram of a uniform fluorescent slide in photon-counting mode and take the variance-to-mean ratio to obtain the effective F; check whether SNR rises as √N for 1, 4 and 16 frame averages; measure steady-state temperature rise in a phantom at several average powers with a thermocouple and compare with the linear model.
units.failure: 把偵測器增益調到最高以求亮度，暗計數與增益雜訊上升，而光子數並未增加，影像看似更亮卻 SNR 更差；同時高功率長時間掃描使組織溫升超過 2 K，神經活動本身被改變。~Turning detector gain to maximum for brightness raises dark counts and gain noise without adding photons, so the image looks brighter but has worse SNR; meanwhile long high-power scans push tissue temperature up by more than 2 K and alter the neural activity being studied.
units.misconception: 提高光電倍增管增益可以提高影像的信噪比。~Raising photomultiplier gain improves the image signal-to-noise ratio.

units.anchor: 共振掃描器與像素時脈~Resonant scanner and pixel clock
units.title: 掃描時序、功率閘控與系統整合~Scan timing, power gating and system integration
units.mechanism: 整合階段把雷射、預補償、Pockels 盒、掃描器、物鏡 z 驅動與偵測器納入同一時序。共振掃描器以固定 8 kHz 正弦擺動，雙向取線可達每秒 16,000 條線，但像素停留時間縮到數十奈秒，每像素只落下幾個雷射脈衝，訊號極度受限；振鏡掃描則慢但停留時間長。Pockels 盒在回程與視場外閘控雷射以減少劑量；正弦速度不均需以像素時脈補償，否則視場邊緣被拉伸。~Integration brings the laser, precompensation, Pockels cell, scanners, objective z-drive and detectors into one timing scheme. A resonant scanner oscillates sinusoidally at a fixed 8 kHz and bidirectional acquisition yields 16,000 lines per second, but pixel dwell shrinks to tens of nanoseconds so only a few laser pulses land per pixel and signal is severely limited; galvanometer scanning is slower but dwells longer. The Pockels cell gates the laser during fly-back and outside the field to cut dose, and the nonuniform sinusoidal velocity must be corrected with the pixel clock or the field edges stretch.
units.model: 8 kHz 共振、雙向取線：512 條線需 512/16,000 ≈ 32 ms，幀率約 31 Hz。半週期 62.5 µs 中約 50 µs 可用，512 像素平均停留 ≈ 98 ns，視場中央速度為平均的 π/2 倍，停留 ≈ 62 ns，在 80 MHz 下只有約 5 個脈衝；若改用 4 MHz 雷射則每像素僅 0.25 個脈衝，共振掃描不可行。~Resonant 8 kHz with bidirectional lines: 512 lines take 512/16,000 ≈ 32 ms, about 31 Hz frame rate. Of each 62.5 µs half period about 50 µs is usable, so 512 pixels dwell ≈ 98 ns on average; at the field centre the velocity is π/2 times the mean, dwell ≈ 62 ns, only about 5 pulses at 80 MHz; with a 4 MHz laser only 0.25 pulses per pixel would land, so resonant scanning would be unusable.
units.verify: 用示波器同時觀察共振掃描器的相位回授、像素時脈與 Pockels 閘控訊號，確認閘控在回程期間關閉且像素時脈隨正弦速度變化；以格線標板影像檢查邊緣與中央的比例尺是否一致，偏差超過 1% 時重新校正像素時脈。~Observe the resonant scanner phase feedback, pixel clock and Pockels gating together on an oscilloscope, confirming that gating closes during fly-back and the pixel clock follows the sinusoidal velocity; check with a grid-target image that scale at the edges matches the centre and recalibrate the pixel clock if the deviation exceeds 1%.
units.failure: 共振掃描器相位回授與像素時脈錯位半個像素，雙向取線的奇偶列彼此錯開，影像出現梳狀條紋，細胞輪廓被撕裂。~A half-pixel misalignment between the resonant scanner phase feedback and the pixel clock offsets the odd and even bidirectional lines, producing comb-like striping that tears cell outlines apart.
units.misconception: 共振掃描器越快，影像品質就越好。~A faster resonant scanner always gives better image quality.

units.anchor: 散射假體驗收與交接文件~Scattering-phantom acceptance and handoff record
units.title: 系統驗證、散射假體與工程交接~System validation, scattering phantom and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 驗收要同時在表面與深處證明性能：表面用螢光珠量點擴散函數，深處用含脂肪乳劑的瓊脂假體在 300 µm 處再量一次，判斷散射與球差的退化；用螢光素溶液確認功率平方律與脈衝最短點；用功率計與自相關儀記錄每條波長的樣品面功率與脈衝寬度。交接文件包含 Pockels 對照表、預補償設定對物鏡與波長的表格、各偵測器的 F 值與允收結果，並註明熱安全的平均功率上限。~Acceptance must prove performance at the surface and at depth: beads at the surface for the point-spread function, a lipid-emulsion agarose phantom at 300 µm for a second measurement that reveals scattering and spherical-aberration degradation; fluorescein solution to confirm the power square law and the shortest-pulse setting; and a power meter plus autocorrelator to log sample-plane power and pulse width at each wavelength. The handoff record holds the Pockels lookup table, the precompensation setting per objective and wavelength, each detector's F value and the acceptance results, and states the thermally safe average-power ceiling.
units.model: 允收門檻範例：表面橫向半高寬 ≤ 0.45 µm、軸向 ≤ 1.7 µm（各為理論 0.35 與 1.27 µm 的 1.3 倍）；300 µm 深處半高寬 ≤ 表面值的 1.5 倍；樣品面脈衝 ≤ 120 fs；功率平方律斜率 2.0 ± 0.1；視場邊緣對中央照度 ≥ 0.8；平均功率上限 150 mW（估計溫升 2.7 K）。~Example thresholds: surface lateral FWHM ≤ 0.45 µm and axial ≤ 1.7 µm (1.3 times the theoretical 0.35 and 1.27 µm); FWHM at 300 µm depth ≤ 1.5 times the surface value; sample-plane pulse ≤ 120 fs; square-law slope 2.0 ± 0.1; edge-to-centre illumination ≥ 0.8; average-power ceiling 150 mW (estimated 2.7 K rise).
units.verify: 依清單逐項量測並記錄通過與否；深度測試用同一批假體與珠子以便跨系統比較；完成後把原始珠子疊層、功率序列與自相關曲線連同設定檔一起歸檔，供日後趨勢比對。~Measure each list item and record pass or fail; use the same phantom and bead batch for depth tests so systems can be compared; archive the raw bead stacks, power series and autocorrelation traces together with the configuration files for later trend comparison.
units.failure: 驗收只在蓋玻片表面測珠子而不做深度假體，交付後在 300 µm 深處才發現球差使軸向半高寬達 4 µm，問題來自物鏡校正環未依深度設定，卻已無基準可追溯。~Accepting on surface beads alone without a depth phantom leaves spherical aberration undiscovered until a 4 µm axial FWHM appears at 300 µm after delivery, caused by an objective correction collar not set for depth, with no baseline left to trace it.
units.misconception: 表面的點擴散函數合格，深層成像品質就有保證。~A good surface point-spread function guarantees image quality at depth.

example: 深度與色散練習：920 nm、80 MHz、樣品面 15 mW、NA 1.0 水鏡、δ = 30 GM。由單元一的公式，10 mW 時 n_a ≈ 0.14，15 mW 時按 P² 放大為 0.14×2.25 ≈ 0.31 光子對/分子/脈衝。若顯微鏡 5000 fs² 的色散未補償，脈衝從 100 fs 展寬到 171 fs，n_a 降為 0.31×100/171 ≈ 0.18。在 400 µm 深處、l_s = 200 µm，到達焦點的彈道功率只有 15×e⁻² ≈ 2.0 mW，n_a 再乘 (2.0/15)² ≈ 0.018 變成 0.0033，訊號幾乎消失。要在 400 µm 回到 0.31，需先做預補償，再把表面功率提高到 15×e² ≈ 111 mW，依每 100 mW 約 1.8 K 估計溫升約 2 K；若改用 1300 nm、l_s = 350 µm，所需功率為 15×e^(400/350) ≈ 47 mW，溫升不到 1 K，但水的吸收較高且可用螢光蛋白受限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Depth and dispersion exercise: 920 nm, 80 MHz, 15 mW at the sample, NA 1.0 water objective, δ = 30 GM. From the unit-one formula n_a ≈ 0.14 at 10 mW, so at 15 mW it scales with P² to 0.14×2.25 ≈ 0.31 photon pairs per molecule per pulse. If the microscope's 5000 fs² of dispersion is uncompensated the pulse stretches from 100 to 171 fs and n_a falls to 0.31×100/171 ≈ 0.18. At 400 µm depth with l_s = 200 µm only 15×e⁻² ≈ 2.0 mW of ballistic power reaches the focus, so n_a is multiplied by (2.0/15)² ≈ 0.018 and becomes 0.0033, nearly no signal. To recover 0.31 at 400 µm, first precompensate, then raise the surface power to 15×e² ≈ 111 mW, with a heating estimate of about 2 K at 1.8 K per 100 mW; switching to 1300 nm with l_s = 350 µm needs only 15×e^(400/350) ≈ 47 mW and under 1 K of heating, but water absorption is higher and fewer fluorescent proteins are usable. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: Maria Göppert-Mayer 在 1931 年的博士論文中預測雙光子吸收，但要等到 1990 年 Denk、Strickler 與 Webb 在康乃爾大學把飛秒染料雷射與雷射掃描顯微鏡結合，才首次示範雙光子螢光成像。1990 年代鈦藍寶石雷射的商品化讓技術普及，2000 年代起神經科學以雙光子在活體腦中記錄鈣訊號，Svoboda 等實驗室並公開模組化顯微鏡設計；2010 年代的 1300 與 1700 nm 長波長激發與三光子成像把深度推向 1 mm 以上。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~Maria Göppert-Mayer predicted two-photon absorption in her 1931 doctoral thesis, but only in 1990 did Denk, Strickler and Webb at Cornell University combine a femtosecond dye laser with a laser-scanning microscope to demonstrate two-photon fluorescence imaging. Commercial Ti:sapphire lasers in the 1990s spread the technique, from the 2000s neuroscience used two-photon imaging to record calcium signals in living brains, and laboratories such as Svoboda's published modular microscope designs; in the 2010s long-wavelength excitation at 1300 and 1700 nm and three-photon imaging pushed depth beyond 1 mm. This course rebuilds only public principles and engineering logic.
